gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Rounded, inflated bowls fill out the lines in Noto Sans Tifinagh, a sans-serif that stays open and inviting. Unica One is the sharper partner, drawing every curve with a single constant stroke and a big lowercase eye.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Tall, crisp, and unfussy. Noto Sans Tirhuta brings a dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave big gaps, while Unica One keeps every stroke the same width as a display heading.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Unica One draws every stroke like bent wire, with a huge lowercase eye and daylight inside each curve. Noto Sans Ugaritic follows with barely any gap between x-height and caps, its open mouths easy going over a full page.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-vai: Chunky and confident. Noto Sans Vai sets words as solid blocks with generous room where curves meet stems, while Unica One's unswelling curves and huge lowercase eye give the heading its edge.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Compact and open, with a gentle step from caps to lowercase. Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps its a, c, e and s open-throated, so a long page of it moves along smoothly without a snag.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Heavy and hulking, like thick chalk pressed down hard, the lowercase of Noto Sans Wancho fills the line with presence, and its e leaves a wide gap at the terminal. Paragraphs feel sturdy.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-warang-cit: Sturdy and contemporary, Unica One holds every stroke as constant as bent wire, with a big lowercase eye and open curves. And Noto Sans Warang Citi handles the quieter job, setting words as solid blocks with wide channels leading into each counter.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-yi: Commanding is the feeling Unica One gives off, with strokes that move like a marker nib ignoring direction. And its best work happens big and short, while Noto Sans Yi stays modern behind it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square brings a soaring x-height and wide gaps. Its strongest quality is how crisp it stays at tiny sizes, which gives Unica One's pipe-cleaner lines a sturdy, approachable partner.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-traditional-nus: Approachable from the first line, Noto Traditional Nushu uses a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, under Unica One's constant-width arms and legs. Its bowls fill every line.
